requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU shall set Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor to True if any of the following signals are True:
Rotor_Ref_Bad_Monitor
Pre_Drive_Supply_Bad_Monitor
And False otherwise.

notes.text: Note: Rotor_Ref_Bad_Monitor and Pre_Drive_Supply_Bad_Monitor are contained within the FPGA_FRAME_SYNC_REG as defined in Table 1401

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU shall delay the rising edge transition of Hi_Enable_Envelope
to yield Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope with a delay of 4 +/- 2 msec.

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU shall delay the rising edge transition of Valve_On
to yield Valve_On_Delay with a delay of 4 +/- 2 msec.

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU software shall compute the Speed_Loop_Clear flag as follow:
if (Low_Threshold_Anomaly_NodeB_Monitor = TRUE OR Hi_Enable_Delay_Envelope = FALSE)
Then
Set Speed_Loop_Clear = TRUE
else
Set Speed_Loop_Clear = FALSE

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
While in Running Mode, the LRU shall transition from Idle State to Speed State on Primary and Spoiler surfaces if all of the following conditions are met:
Elec_En_STL is equal to TRUE
Rect_ok_Dbnce_Lgc is equal to TRUE
STL_Bad_Message is equal to FALSE
Elec_Bad_Monitor_LRU is equal to FALSE.

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text: The LRU software shall set the Hi_Enable_Envelope to TRUE while in the Speed_State_StateLgc.

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU software shall transition from Idle_Mode_StateLgc to Location_State_StateLgc on primary surfaces if all the following conditions are met:
Bus_OK_Message is equal to TRUE
Rect_ok_Dbnce_Lgc is equal to FALSE
Hyd_ok_Dbnce_Lgc is equal to FALSE

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU software shall energize the MSV solenoid for primary surfaces (LRU_1, LRU_2, LRU_5, LRU_6, LRU_7) while in Location_State_StateLgc by setting the following bits:
Valve_On to TRUE using the FPGA register DSP_Control register bit in Table 1401.
Valve_On discrete IO to TRUE using the VALVE_ENABLE_DSP Pin function in Table 1409.

metadata.safety_rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

requirements.requirement_text:
The LRU software shall map the discrete input/output functions per the following pin configurations:
